name: Clonenames
description: Self-hosted Codenames-style word guessing game: two teams, a grid of secret words, and spymasters giving one-word clues. Create a room, share the 5-letter code, and everyone plays from their own browser on your LAN — spymaster view and guesser view are synced live via Socket.IO. Includes multiple word lists. Rooms are in-memory and ephemeral — no persistent data, no accounts, no volumes needed. All assets are served locally, so it works with zero internet. No authentication by design — keep it LAN-only.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Clonenames web UI. (The app listens on container port 12345.)
